name: Edward Staples
bio:
Edward Staples is a highly skilled tattoo artist, specializing in traditional styles, his work characterized as clean, bold, and solid. Based in Broughty Ferry, Dundee, he is reputed as the fastest tattooer in Scotland, and his fine craftsmanship has garnered him well over a hundred thousand followers on Instagram. He showcases his impressive freehand drawing through videos, providing a glimpse into his extraordinary talent. His extreme professionalism shines through in all aspects of his work, truly setting him apart in the field.
